name: loom_of_nights
theme: a weaver's night workshop becomes the cosmic web — down through a half-woven tapestry to its weave, a single fiber and its braided filaments, out to the dark-matter scaffold, then back down to the valley the workshop stands in

registers.name: workshop
registers.scene: a moonlit weaving workshop seen wide from the open doorway, heavy timber rafters overhead, the walls racked with cones of dyed yarn in indigo and saffron, a great upright loom at the far wall strung with pale warp threads, a brass lamp burning gold on the workbench, empty, no one present
registers.target: a half-woven tapestry, a night landscape worked in indigo and saffron thread
registers.loop_target: a moonlit weaving workshop, a great loom holding a half-woven tapestry, cones of dyed yarn and a brass lamp on the workbench, empty

registers.name: tapestry
registers.palette: midnight indigo with one saffron thread line
registers.scene: the face of a half-woven tapestry filling the view, a night landscape worked in dyed thread, indigo hills and a saffron thread river across them, small gold knots scattered through the dark slopes, the ridged texture of the weave raised over every shape
registers.target: a bare patch of plain weave, saffron and indigo strands crossing over and under

registers.name: weave_grid
registers.scene: a strict over-under grid of woven threads filling the view, saffron and ivory strands crossing warp over weft, every crossing a raised square of packed fiber, deep shadow in the channels between
registers.target: an indigo-dyed fiber, a dark twisted strand with short hairs standing off it

registers.name: fiber
registers.scene: a single indigo-dyed fiber filling the view, a thick twisted strand of deep blue, a fine gold strand plied around it, short hairs standing off along its length
registers.target: braided pale gold fibrils, twisted together into ropes with tight knots

registers.name: braid
registers.palette: pale gold and black, blooming into ghost blue
registers.scene: braided filament strands filling the dark, pale gold fibrils twisted together into long ropes, tight knots where the ropes cross, black gaps between them

registers.name: scaffold
registers.scene: the dark-matter scaffold of the universe, ghost-blue luminous filaments braided across the black, dense knots of galaxy clusters where the strands cross, vast dark voids between them
registers.target: a bright spiral galaxy, arms wound tight around a gold core

registers.name: galaxy
registers.scene: a tilted spiral galaxy filling the black, saffron and white arms wound around a blazing gold core, dark dust lanes threaded between the arms
registers.target: a bright golden star, ringed by sharp bands of dust

registers.name: spun_disk
registers.scene: a white star inside a spun disk of dust, sharp concentric silver-blue rings circling the core, clean dark gaps cut between the rings
registers.target: a deep indigo planet, thin gold lines threaded over its dark face

registers.name: planet
registers.scene: a huge indigo planet filling the view, its night side turned outward, veins of gold river-light over dark continents, a thin bright limb at its edge
registers.target: a wide branching river of gold light

registers.name: nightlands
registers.scene: dark mountain country at night seen from high above, a gold river along the valley floor between black ridges, pale snow on the high peaks
registers.target: a small stone village of lamplit windows

registers.name: hamlet
registers.scene: a lamplit weaving hamlet on the valley floor, stone cottages with steep slate roofs, tall drying frames hung with long dyed cloths in indigo and saffron along the lanes, warm gold windows in the dark, empty, no one present

music_theme: a moonlit weaving room, patient and hypnotic — a plucked thread-like ostinato over a deep drone, opening into wide cold strings on the braid-to-cosmic-web seam, settling back to a warm lamplit close
